articles.title: The Red Sox brass say it is ‘complicated’ to evaluate 2026. Beyond the streak, what to make of it?
articles.description: They were a team capable of contending, maybe, but nothing beyond that — at least when you look at run differential.

articles.title: Rays sweep away Yankees, head to ALCS for first time since 2020
articles.description: Victor Mesa Jr. hit a tiebreaking, two-run homer in the sixth inning, and Tampa Bay ousted host New York with the help of a fan interference call.

articles.title: Andy Pages delivers go-ahead single as Dodgers oust Braves from NL playoffs
articles.description: His bases-loaded hit drove in a pair in the seventh inning to put Los Angeles up for good, clinching a berth in the NLCS.

articles.title: Jo Adell, José Ramírez star as Guardians beat White Sox to avoid ALDS elimination
articles.description: Adell and Ramírez powered Cleveland with a pair of two-out triples to keep the Guardians' season alive.

articles.title: Padres avoid elimination, beat Brewers 4-3 in NLDS Game 3 with Cronenworth’s HR, King’s relief
articles.description: Jake Cronenworth hit a tiebreaking homer, Michael King pitched the final two innings on one day of rest and the Padres trimmed Milwaukee's lead to 2-1.

articles.title: Red Sox roster reset: Every player’s contract status entering the offseason
articles.description: With the lineup in particular again meriting supplements, it figures to be another interesting go-around for the front office.

articles.title: Alex Cora will not pursue Phillies’ managerial position
articles.description: Cora's 620 victories are third in Red Sox history.

articles.title: Yoshinobu Yamamoto is dominant again as Dodgers take 2-1 series lead over Braves
articles.description: The Dodgers are trying to advance and become the first National League team to win three straight World Series.

articles.title: No matter how Craig Breslow tries to frame it, the Red Sox haven’t proven anything under his watch
articles.description: Breslow sounded downright Dan Duquette-esque ("More days in first place ...") during his season sign-off press conference.

articles.title: The Red Sox didn’t upgrade their home run power last offseason. Can they this year?
articles.description: After last season, the free agent market featured several top- or middle-of-the-order threats. That's not the case this year.

articles.title: Small-ball Rays beat sloppy Yankees for 2-0 ALDS lead
articles.description: Richie Palacios hit a two-run single in a four-run fifth inning, and host Tampa Bay took advantage of four New York errors to beat Cam Schlittler and the Yankees.

articles.title: White Sox surge past Guardians to take 2-0 lead in ALDS, move one win away from ALCS
articles.description: Braden Montgomery's two-run double put Chicago in front, and Sean Burke tossed 5⅓ innings of one-hit relief to beat Cleveland.

articles.title: Red Sox believe Roman Anthony won’t need surgery to fix right hand injury
articles.description: Roman Anthony dealt with a recurrence of an injury to his right ring finger as well as other hand issues in the first of the Red Sox’ two postseason games.

articles.title: No matter what they say, the Red Sox are a second-tier team until they prove otherwise
articles.description: The Sox also have gone eight years without winning the division and five years without winning 90 games.

articles.title: Craig Breslow and Chad Tracy meet with Willson Contreras, defend Red Sox’ in-game moves: ‘It’s my decision. It went south.’
articles.description: Tracy said he has spoken with Sonny Gray, who was unhappy about being pulled in the fifth inning of what turned out to be the Red Sox’ last game of the season.

articles.title: Craig Breslow, Chad Tracy, Sam Kennedy hold Red Sox end-of-season press conference | Replay
articles.description: The team's management triumvirate addressed Boston's postseason exit, the impending labor battle, and more with reporters.
